title: High-throughput Sequencing of exosomal circRNAs in large artery atherosclerotic stroke
description: Exosomal circRNA sequencing was used to identify differentially expressed circRNAs between LAA stroke and normal controls. From a further validation stage, the results were validated using RT-qPCR. Overall design: Plasma exosomal circRNAs profiles of large artery atherosclerotic stroke and healthy controls
